subject: 🏃 Monday — Hip Complex Circuit + PT (Wk 9)
html:
Tomorrow: Hip Complex Circuit + PT (~20 min) — mobility and activation only, no running. This is the first day of Week 9, Phase 3: Peak Volume & Power. You're 27 days out from the SF Marathon.

The session: 90/90 switches, adductor rockbacks, foam roller T-spine extensions (8–10 reps). Then the full PT block — dead bug with banded pulldown (2–3 sets, slow marches), chin tuck + lifts (front + diagonal, 2 reps each direction, 3-sec hold), side plank with hip abduction (top toe pointing toward the floor), and quadruped banded hip IR (5–10 reps each side). Finish with standing lunges focusing on hip IR + extension (8–10 reps).

Focus cue: Treat this as a systems check. The deload week reset you — now pay attention to how everything moves. Any stiffness in the hips? Is the right hamstring twinge from Jun 24 still talking, or has it cleared? Log what you feel, because Tuesday is 6×1600m at threshold — the first real quality session in two weeks — and I want to know your body's starting point heading into the volume jump.

Context: Week 9 is a significant step-up: ~44 miles with a 16-mi long run (8 @ MP) on Sunday, plus a midweek 10-mi medium-long on Thursday that's new distance for you. The deload absorbed the Presidio fatigue and you came out of it running clean Z2 with the knee at 1/5 — that's the foundation we're building on. The #1 project for the back half remains fueling at effort — Sunday's 16-miler is the first big Maurten rehearsal since the Presidio lesson. Tomorrow just gets the chassis ready.

Get to bed by 10. Lay out your track gear for Tuesday — you'll want the morning dialed for 6×1600m.
